say:1:1421612001:1.text: Mina, let me take a good look at you! Thank the stars, no injuries, no marks...
say:1:1421612001:1.source_cn: 米娜，让我看看你！没有受伤，也没有被施加印记！

say:2:1421612002:1.text: Oh, I'm so glad you're safe! I've been worried sick!
say:2:1421612002:1.source_cn: 你没事真是太好了！我一直在担心你！

say:3:1421612003:1.text: I ran into some real danger out in the wilds. Ewan and Magister Merlin found me just in time...
say:3:1421612003:1.source_cn: 我在野外遇到了危险，幸好埃文和这位梅林大人及时找到了我……
say:3:1421612003:1.male: I ran into some real danger out in the wilds. Ewan and Magister Merlin found me just in time...
say:3:1421612003:1.female: I ran into some real danger out in the wilds. Ewan and Magister Merlin found me just in time...

say:4:1421612004:1.text: Enough about me. Delina, listen, do you have any spare coconut oil by any chance? Ewan desperately needs some, and the market stalls are all closed by now.
say:4:1421612004:1.source_cn: 不说这些了，德琳，你这里有没有多余的香椰油？埃文有急用...

say:5:1421612005:1.text: I only have a tiny bit left... But still, never mind that, take it! Helping Ewan out of this tight spot is what matters most!
say:5:1421612005:1.source_cn: 有是有，但只剩下最后一点了……没事，你拿走吧！先帮埃文...

say:6:1421612006:1.text: But Delina... what if your master finds out?

say:7:1421612007:1.text: If I'm found out, I'll come running to you for help. You won't just leave me behind will you?
say:7:1421612007:1.source_cn: 如果被发现，我再来找你们帮忙嘛！等那个时候，你可不要不管我！

say:8:1421612008:1.text: Right then! I'll go meet Ewan at the market. I know he'll want to thank you in person once this is all resolved!
say:8:1421612008:1.source_cn: 我明白了，我先去市集找埃文，事情解决后他一定会亲自来感...

say:1:1421613001:0.text: I got the last honey amber!
say:1:1421613001:0.source_cn: 我买到最后一块蜂琥珀了！

say:2:1421613002:0.text: I have the coconut oil as well! Delina's expecting a proper thank you from you.
say:2:1421613002:0.source_cn: 香椰油我也拿到了！德琳让你好好谢谢她呢。

say:3:1421613003:0.text: That goes without saying! Now, the most crucial step—making Mystic Dew!
say:3:1421613003:0.source_cn: 我会的！接下来就是最关键的一步——自制秘露了！

choice_prompt:4:1421613003.text: That goes without saying! Now, the most crucial step—making Mystic Dew!
choice_prompt:4:1421613003.source_cn: 我会的！接下来就是最关键的一步——自制秘露了！

say:5:1421613004:0.text: Actually, I'm not quite sure either... Let me check the recipe.
say:5:1421613004:0.source_cn: 其实我也一知半解……我找找那张配方。
say:5:1421613004:0.male: Actually, I'm not quite sure either... Let me check the recipe.

document:6:189:0.text:
Gently heat the <style="highlight">coconut oil</style> using a double boiler method.
Add the <style="highlight">honey amber</style> and stir continuously until it is fully dissolved.
Then, remove the petals and leaves from the budding <style="highlight">etching irises</style>. Briefly steep the remaining roots and stems in the warm mixture, then strain them out to infuse their distinct fragrance into the oil.

A solemn word: This recipe was created to aid fellow servants suffering mistreatment at the hands of their masters. Do not, under any circumstances, divulge it to nobles or any individual who would exploit its secrets for personal gain!
document:6:189:0.source_cn:
将<style="highlight">香椰油</style>低温隔水加热。
加入<style="highlight">蜂琥珀</style>并持续搅拌，直至其完全溶解。
最后将<style="highlight">含苞的蚀芯花</style>去除花瓣及叶片，根茎在溶液中短暂浸泡后滤出，保留其香味。
另：本配方制作的原意是帮助其他被主人刁难的仆从，请勿将它泄露给贵族或任何想借配方牟利的人！
